Adjudicate a build phase

Source: R/build.R
dp_build.Rd

Reconciles each power's unit count with its supply-centre count. A power with centres to spare may build in its own home centres, provided it still owns them and they are empty; fleets may only be built in coastal home centres, naming a coast where the province has more than one. A power with too many units must disband the difference, and any shortfall in its orders is made up by the civil-disorder rule: the unit furthest from home goes first, a fleet before an army at equal distance, ties broken alphabetically.

Usage

dp_build(game, orders = NULL, call = rlang::caller_env())

Arguments

game

A dp_game object in a build phase.

orders

A dp_orders tibble, or a character vector of orders such as "Build A Par" and "Remove F Bre".

call

Caller environment, for error reporting. Experts only.

Value

A dp_result object with the new unit positions, the units built and the units disbanded.

See also

Other engine: dp_adjudicate(), dp_advance(), dp_play(), dp_result, dp_retreat(), dp_step(), is_dp_result()

Examples

g <- dp_example_game("build")
dp_build(g, "Germany: Build A Ber")
#> <dp_result> Winter 1902 (build phase)
#> • 2 of 2 orders succeeded
#> • 0 units dislodged
#> • 0 provinces left contested
#> • 1 unit disbanded
#> • 1 unit built
